title: Ils ne sont pas marxistes: r/LeftistsForAI, Marx's Legacy, and the Left's Lost Capacity for Internal Critique
sentence: The REP collective, writing in September 1969, called the expulsion of Progressive Labor "done in an unprincipled manner," said the anti-PL factions "could unite in June, with little political discussion, to expel PL," and noted that "there was not adequate discussion." Expelling PL held together a coalition whose own internal differences, between RYM II and Weatherman, had not been debated ([REP collective](https://www.marxists.org/history/erol/ncm-1/rep-sds.pdf)).
